title: 第155章 苏醒
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

那是一双什么样的眼睛？

眼瞳是极深极深的黑色，像是一潭沉寂了数千年的古井。

但此刻，那双眼睛里没有任何情绪。

没有迷茫，没有愤怒，没有悲伤。

只有一片空洞。

她看着眼前的一切，像是在看一个完全不认识的陌生世界。

然后——

她的右手猛然抬了起来。

没有人看清她的动作。

只看见一道凌厉的青色剑芒从她指尖激射而出，剑气之强、之快，快到连掌刑天官的天刑尺都慢了半拍。

那道剑芒直直地朝张瑀的方向斩了过去！

“张小友！”季伯渊在通道入口处惊呼了一声。

掌刑天官的天刑尺几乎是同一时间劈了下去。

淡金色的尺影和青色剑芒在半空中撞在一起。

一声震耳欲聋的巨响！

整个地下宫殿的地面都剧烈震了一下。

剑气激荡的余波朝着四面八方狂涌而出，撞在千机阵师的隔灵阵上，光壁剧烈地颤动着，发出了刺耳的嗡鸣声。

几位修为稍低的长老被震得往后退了好几步。

季伯渊的脸色也微微变了一下。

他修行数十年，金丹后期的修为在苍玄界已算一方人物，但刚才那股剑气的余波，竟然让他有种心悸的感觉。

这还是在隔灵阵削弱了九成威力之后的效果。

如果没有隔灵阵，刚才那一剑，恐怕连他都要挂彩。

掌刑天官站在原地，身形纹丝没动。

他右手中的天刑尺依然横在身前，尺面上的金字比刚才更加明亮了几分。

但他的眉头却微微皱了起来。

刚才那一剑的威力，比他预想的要强。

元婴巅峰。

这个沉睡了四千年的女人，虽然修为已经跌落了一个大境界，但她的剑意和剑气精纯度，却丝毫不亚于寻常的化神初期修士。

直播间里的弹幕吓得魂飞魄散。

【卧槽！！她真的暴起了！！】

【那一剑太快了！我都没看清！就看一道青光闪过！】

【主播小心！别靠太近！】

【她是不是还没清醒？以为是在天裂之变那场大战里？】

【有可能！睡了四千年，醒来第一反应肯定是杀敌！】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

What kind of eyes are those?

The pupils of the eyes were extremely deep black, like an ancient well that had been silent for thousands of years.

But at this moment, there was no emotion in those eyes.

No confusion, no anger, no sadness.

There was just a void.

She looked at everything in front of her as if she were looking at a completely unfamiliar world.

Then——

Her right hand suddenly rose.

No one could see her movements clearly.

All she saw was a sharp green sword light shooting out from her fingertips. The sword energy was so strong and so fast that even the Heavenly Punishment Ruler used to punish the Heavenly Official was half a beat slower.

The sword light slashed straight in the direction of Zhang Yu!

"Zhang Xiaoyou!" Ji Boyuan exclaimed at the entrance of the passage.

The Heavenly Punishment Ruler used to punish the Heavenly Official fell down almost at the same time.

The pale golden ruler shadow and the cyan sword light collided in mid-air.

There was a deafening bang!

The ground of the entire underground palace shook violently.

The aftermath of the sword energy surged out in all directions and hit the Qianji Formation Master's Spirit Separation Formation. The light wall trembled violently and made a harsh buzzing sound.

Several elders with lower cultivation levels were shocked and took several steps back.

Ji Boyuan's expression also changed slightly.

He has been practicing for decades, and his cultivation in the later stage of Jindan is already considered a figure in the Cangxuan world, but the aftermath of the sword energy just now actually gave him a feeling of palpitations.

This is the effect after the spirit separation array has weakened 90% of its power.

If there was no spirit separation formation, that sword blow just now would probably even cause him to lose.

Zhang Xingtianguan stood on the spot, his figure not moving at all.

The Heavenly Punishment Ruler in his right hand was still lying in front of him, and the gold characters on the ruler were a little brighter than before.

But his brows wrinkled slightly.

The power of the sword just now was stronger than he expected.

The peak of Nascent Soul.

Although this woman who has been sleeping for four thousand years has fallen to a great level in cultivation, her sword intention and sword energy purity are no less than those of an ordinary early stage cultivator.

The barrage in the live broadcast room scared me to death.

【Fuck!!She really got angry!!】

[That sword was too fast!I didn't even see it clearly!Just watch a flash of green light!】

[Anchor be careful!Don't get too close!】

[Is she still awake?Think it was during the battle of the Sky Splitting Incident?】

【It's possible!After sleeping for four thousand years, the first reaction when waking up must be to kill the enemy!】
